prompt: For each month end of 2025, show LedgerLoop's MRR from subscriptions billed in euros (currency EUR) and the change from the month end before: this month end's MRR minus the previous month end's. A subscription's MRR on a date is the sum of its subscription_events.mrr_delta_local with event_date on or before that date; every event counts, opening events included. fx_rates holds a row for every day of 2024 and 2025, so it can list the month ends. The month end before January 2025 is 31 December 2024, so January has a change too. Return three columns, in this order: month_end (the last day of the month), mrr_eur and change_eur. Return one row for each month end of 2025. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, list the month ends from December 2024 on (the last day fx_rates holds in each month), work out the MRR at each, then compare each month end with the one before.
Take the change before you keep only 2025: if you filter first, January loses December 2024's month end.
why_this_works: Summing every event up to each month end gives the MRR in force; the window runs before the 2025 filter, so January compares with December 2024.
